answers.puzzle_1_rating_reason: This one was really hard, lack of info to make next moves made it difficult to progress with the puzzle
answers.puzzle_2_rating_reason: Lots of opening moves at the beginning made it easy to complete the rest of the puzzle also I think I just got better after the first one
answers.puzzle_3_rating_reason: Also lots of opening moves that made it easy to continue with the rest of the puzzle
answers.strategy:
Every time I fill in a square, I look to the vertical and horizontal columns that square affects to see if I can fill in any of the other ones
Blocking the moves to the side when they are invalid
Check after every move if I can logically fill in the other squares to complete columns or rows based off of previously impossible / blocked  squares
